notes: The Control Panel now matches its design exactly. Comparing the theme’s own reference drawing against the running app found nine differences; all of them are gone.
Text weight is now part of the theme. Ninety-eight weights were fixed in place, which is why the whole window read lighter than the design intended no matter what else changed.
Section panels, list rows and sidebar headings now take their surface, height and lettering from the theme rather than from the app.
